blocks.text: The leading newly prioritized issue is **CVE-2026-129448 (Apache Roller)**, a critical unsafe deserialization flaw; it is listed in CISA KEV on 2026-11-20 (exploitation confirmed by CISA) and reported exploited by ENISA EUVD since 2026-11-20. A fixed release is identified (roller 6.1.5). **CVE-2026-133968 (MONAI Label)** is another important newly highlighted issue; it is described in its CVE record as exploited in the wild (not yet corroborated by CISA KEV, Project Zero, EUVD or VulnCheck).

blocks.text: **Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed Apache Roller (CVE-2026-129448); (2) isolate or patch exposed MONAI Label (CVE-2026-133968); (3) isolate or patch exposed Broadcom VMware vCenter (CVE-2026-123890); (4) isolate or patch exposed Cisco Expressway Series (CVE-2026-76466); (5) examine Apache Roller hosts for unexpected child processes and outbound connections.

**CVE-2026-129448 - Apache Roller unsafe deserialization (CVSS 9.8).** Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Apache Roller versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The XML-RPC endpoint accepts vendor extension types and deserializes them before authenticating the requester. This is the same vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384, which listed only Apache Roller 6.1.5 as affected. This issue is being actively exploited. Affected releases (NVD): roller >= 4.0, < 6.1.5. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): roller 6.1.5. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-133968 - MONAI Label path traversal (CVSS 9.8).** monailabel (aka MONAI Label) through 0.8.5 allows directory traversal, with resultant remote code execution, via the image parameter to the PUT /datastore/image endpoint, as exploited in the wild starting in September 2026. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-123890 - Broadcom VMware vCenter authentication bypass (CVSS 9.8).** VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service. Affected versions: 9.1.x (fixed in 9.1.1.0200); 9.0.x (fixed in 9.0.2.0200); 8.0 (fixed in 8.0 U3m); 5.x (fixed in 5.2.5). Telco Cloud Platform 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2 and Telco Cloud Infrastructure 3.0 are also affected (see KB463116). Affected releases (NVD): cloud foundation >= 5.0, < 5.2.5; telco cloud infrastructure = 3.0; telco cloud platform >= 3.0, <= 5.2; +4 more. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): cloud foundation 5.2.5, vcenter server 9.0.2.0200, vcenter server 9.1.1.0200. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-76466 - Cisco Expressway Series hard-coded credentials (CVSS 9.8).** A vulnerability in the database service feature of Cisco Expressway Series could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker with network access to a Cisco Expressway device to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root. This vulnerability is due to the use of persistent cookies. Affected releases (NVD): expressway < x15.5.20. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): expressway x15.5.20. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2025-42884 - SAP NetWeaver SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability (CVSS 6.5).** SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal allows an unauthenticated attacker to inject JNDI environment properties or pass a URL used during JNDI lookup operations, enabling access to an unintended JNDI provider. This could further lead to disclosure or modification of information about the server. There is no impact on availability. Affected releases (NVD): netweaver enterprise portal = 7.50. Fixed package release: not mapped in NVD ranges; 1 vendor patch or advisory reference available. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

No new CISA KEV additions were verified in the reporting window. The latest additions remain the 4 entries added November 20, 2026: SAP NetWeaver, Broadcom VMware vCenter, Apache Roller and Cisco Expressway Series. The federal remediation deadline for those entries is **November 23, 2026**. This deadline applies to covered federal agencies under applicable requirements; it is not a universal private-sector mandate.

**Defensive hunting:** for Apache Roller (CVE-2026-129448), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host; for MONAI Label (CVE-2026-133968), inspect unexpected file writes outside the application's data directories, new web-accessible files, modified application code, altered SSH authorized_keys files and suspicious scheduled jobs; for Broadcom VMware vCenter (CVE-2026-123890), review administrative logins, newly created accounts or API tokens, and configuration changes made without a matching change record; for Cisco Expressway Series (CVE-2026-76466), review administrative logins, newly created accounts or API tokens, and configuration changes made without a matching change record.
